abyssal_gaze.name: Abyssal Gaze
abyssal_gaze.description: Strike the creature you look at with wither II for 6 s and blindness plus darkness for 4 s.

abyssal_tether.name: Abyssal Tether
abyssal_tether.description: Strike the looked-at target within 12 blocks, pulling it to you with Weakness for 5 s.

ancestors_mercy.name: Ancestor's Mercy
ancestors_mercy.description: Create a 5-block area for 5 seconds that heals allies 1 health per second and soulburns enemies.

arc_palm.name: Arc Palm
arc_palm.description: Strike the creature you look at; lightning arcs to up to 3 creatures within 4 blocks of it.

balanced_judgment.name: Balanced Judgment
balanced_judgment.description: Strike the creature you look at for holy damage equal to the health-percentage gap between you, minimum 4.

ball_lightning.name: Ball Lightning
ball_lightning.description: Launch a slow orb that zaps enemies within 2 blocks of its path every half second.

beacon_flare.name: Beacon Flare
beacon_flare.description: Throw a flare that lights a 6-block area for 6 s, giving enemies glowing and allies speed I.

blessed_bread.name: Blessed Bread
blessed_bread.description: Conjure 3 bread that restore 6 hunger and grant regeneration I and night vision for 30 s.

blessed_font.name: Blessed Font
blessed_font.description: A 5-block font pulses for 6 s, healing allies 2 HP every 2 s and extinguishing fire.

blink_fuse.name: Blink Fuse
blink_fuse.description: For 6 s, the first time you are hit you teleport 5 blocks away and gain Speed III 3 s.

bloom_lash.name: Bloom Lash
bloom_lash.description: A 5-block cone of vines roots enemies with Slowness V 3 s and heals allies 3 HP.

bogberry_brew.name: Bogberry Brew
bogberry_brew.description: Conjure a brew; drinking grants Regeneration I 15 s and Water Breathing 60 s.

borealis_veil.name: Borealis Veil
borealis_veil.description: For 10 s, attackers that hit you are struck by a small lightning bolt and frozen 2 s, once per 2 s.

bottomless_ladle.name: Bottomless Ladle
bottomless_ladle.description: Strike the looked-at target, filling its lungs: drowning damage for 3 s and soulburn 4 s.

brine_lance.name: Brine Lance
brine_lance.description: Throw a lance of icy brine that freezes the target 3 s and applies Slowness III for 4 s.

broken_halo.name: Broken Halo
broken_halo.description: Throw a shattered halo that applies Wither 3 s to the target and heals you 2 HP.

chochin_swarm.name: Chochin Swarm
chochin_swarm.description: Summon 3 paper-lantern vexes for 20 s that burst for 3 damage in 2 blocks when they die.

cloud_somersault.name: Cloud Somersault
cloud_somersault.description: Leap 10 blocks forward and gain Slow Falling for 5 seconds.

conductive_mark.name: Conductive Mark
conductive_mark.description: Mark a target to glow 12 s; arrows hitting it chain lightning to 2 nearby enemies.

cursed_coin.name: Cursed Coin
cursed_coin.description: Throw a cursed coin; the creature hit gets slowness II and takes +20% damage for 8 s.

dawn_bell.name: Dawn Bell
dawn_bell.description: Ring a bell that clears negative effects from allies within 6 blocks and makes enemies glow for 10 seconds.

divine_verdict.name: Divine Verdict
divine_verdict.description: Mark a target for 10 s; if it dies, lightning strikes the 3 nearest enemies.

drunken_sway.name: Drunken Sway
drunken_sway.description: For 8 seconds, each hit against you has a 50% chance to miss as you stagger 2 blocks aside.

eldritch_arc.name: Eldritch Arc
eldritch_arc.description: Throw a cursed spark that chains to 3 enemies, applying Wither for 4 s.

fallen_grace.name: Fallen Grace
fallen_grace.description: For 10 s each kill grants you Absorption I and heals allies within 5 blocks 2 HP.

flowing_counter.name: Flowing Counter
flowing_counter.description: For 8 seconds, after each dodge your next unarmed hit deals +6 damage and knocks back with a water burst.

frozen_fingers.name: Frozen Fingers
frozen_fingers.description: Strike the looked-at target, freezing it 2 s and stealing one of its positive effects.

galvanic_downpour.name: Galvanic Downpour
galvanic_downpour.description: A 6-block area rains for 6 s, dealing lightning damage each second, doubled against wet enemies.

glacial_hex.name: Glacial Hex
glacial_hex.description: Mark a target with Weakness for 10 s; if it dies, frozen shards freeze enemies within 4 blocks for 4 s.

grapeshot_blast.name: Grapeshot Blast
grapeshot_blast.description: Fire a 6-block cone of scattershot dealing 6 damage and strong knockback.

gravity_snare.name: Gravity Snare
gravity_snare.description: Throw a void trap; the first creature to step on it levitates for 3 s and takes 4 void damage.

hallowed_snowfall.name: Hallowed Snowfall
hallowed_snowfall.description: A 6-block area snows for 6 s, healing allies 1 HP per second with Resistance I and slowing undead.

harbour_light.name: Harbour Light
harbour_light.description: Place a light pillar for 15 s giving allies within 8 blocks Night Vision and Regeneration I.

heartwood_shelter.name: Heartwood Shelter
heartwood_shelter.description: Raise a small azalea dome for 10 s that gives Regeneration II to allies inside.

heavenly_facet.name: Heavenly Facet
heavenly_facet.description: Throw a jade prism that bursts in 4 blocks, healing allies 4 HP and giving enemies glowing and -20% armour for 6 s.

ice_cocoon.name: Ice Cocoon
ice_cocoon.description: Encase yourself in ice blocks for 4 seconds, healing 2 health per second inside.

indulgence_coin.name: Indulgence Coin
indulgence_coin.description: Throw a gold coin; the creature hit gets weakness II for 6 s and you gain 4 absorption hearts.

ink_bomb.name: Ink Bomb
ink_bomb.description: Throw an ink sac that blinds enemies within 3 blocks of impact for 4 s.

kagami_frost.name: Kagami Frost
kagami_frost.description: For 8 s, half of melee damage you take is reflected and freezes the attacker 2 s.

kagura_bell.name: Kagura Bell
kagura_bell.description: A 5-block area pulses for 5 s, healing allies 1 HP per second and giving undead slowness II.

koi_leap.name: Koi Leap
koi_leap.description: Dash 6 blocks forward and gain Dolphin's Grace and Speed I for 10 s.

leviathan_hex.name: Leviathan Hex
leviathan_hex.description: Mark a target to take 1 drowning damage per second for 6 s; if it dies, you heal 4 HP.

long_road.name: Long Road
long_road.description: For 20 seconds, sprinting builds Speed up to III and your first hit after sprinting stuns for 1 second.

lotus_arrows.name: Lotus Arrows
lotus_arrows.description: Fire 6 arrows in a ring around you, each applying Slowness II for 4 seconds.

malign_current.name: Malign Current
malign_current.description: For 10 s each kill releases a lightning burst hitting enemies within 3 blocks.

mangrove_thicket.name: Mangrove Thicket
mangrove_thicket.description: Raise a ring of mangrove roots around you for 8 s that blocks enemies.

mantra_of_mercy.name: Mantra of Mercy
mantra_of_mercy.description: For 12 seconds, each unarmed hit heals the lowest-health ally within 8 blocks for 2 health.

mask_of_rule.name: Mask of Rule
mask_of_rule.description: Strike the creature you look at, shattering 30% of its armour for 8 s; your summons deal +30% damage to it.

mercy_wave.name: Mercy Wave
mercy_wave.description: A 6-block wave cone heals allies 4 HP and pushes enemies back 4 blocks.

mind_lift.name: Mind Lift
mind_lift.description: Lift every creature within 5 blocks with Levitation for 2 seconds, then slam them down for fall damage.

mind_splinter.name: Mind Splinter
mind_splinter.description: Strike the creature you look at, applying Nausea and Slowness and making it take 50% more damage for 6 seconds.

mirror_bolt.name: Mirror Bolt
mirror_bolt.description: Dash 6 blocks; a lightning echo at your start point strikes enemies within 3 blocks after 1 s.

mountain_tea.name: Mountain Tea
mountain_tea.description: Conjure a flask of tea; drinking it grants Resistance I and Jump Boost II for 60 seconds.

nomad_stew.name: Nomad Stew
nomad_stew.description: Conjure a hot stew; eating grants Absorption II and Speed I for 60 s.

onigiri_offering.name: Onigiri Offering
onigiri_offering.description: Conjure a rice ball; eating grants Speed I and Haste II for 45 s.

phantom_drift.name: Phantom Drift
phantom_drift.description: Glide 5 blocks through enemies, freezing every creature you pass for 2 s.

pinning_frost.name: Pinning Frost
pinning_frost.description: For 10 s your arrows freeze targets in place for 2 s.

polar_flash.name: Polar Flash
polar_flash.description: A 6-block cone of auroral light deals lightning damage, blinds 2 s and applies Slowness II 4 s.

raiko_fracture.name: Raiko Fracture
raiko_fracture.description: Strike the looked-at target, shattering 5 armour; if its armour reaches 0, it is stunned 2 s.

rain_dance.name: Rain Dance
rain_dance.description: Create a 5-block area for 6 seconds giving allies Regeneration I and Dolphin's Grace and putting out fires.

rift_hop.name: Rift Hop
rift_hop.description: Dash 8 blocks through creatures, dealing 4 void damage and blindness for 2 s to each one passed.

rift_tether.name: Rift Tether
rift_tether.description: For 8 s, your arrows teleport the creature hit 4 blocks toward you.

rooted_trunk.name: Rooted Trunk
rooted_trunk.description: For 6 seconds, you cannot be knocked back and attackers are poisoned for 3 seconds.

rotroot_grasp.name: Rotroot Grasp
rotroot_grasp.description: Roots in a 6-block cone give enemies slowness V for 2 s and weakness I for 6 s.

ruyi_toss.name: Ruyi Toss
ruyi_toss.description: Hurl a spinning staff that pierces creatures in a 10-block line, damaging and knocking them back.

samsara_turn.name: Samsara Turn
samsara_turn.description: For 10 seconds, each kill refills your dodge stamina and grants Resistance I for 5 seconds.

sanctified_icicle.name: Sanctified Icicle
sanctified_icicle.description: Throw a holy icicle that freezes the target 3 s and deals double damage to undead.

sanctuary_tent.name: Sanctuary Tent
sanctuary_tent.description: Build a 3x3 wool shelter around you for 10 s that grants regeneration I to anyone inside.

sea_legs.name: Sea Legs
sea_legs.description: For 20 s gain Dolphin's Grace, Water Breathing and immunity to knockback.

shatter_kick.name: Shatter Kick
shatter_kick.description: Kick the creature you look at 6 blocks back; if it is frozen, it shatters for double damage.

shattering_current.name: Shattering Current
shattering_current.description: A 6-block water cone knocks enemies back and shatters 3 armour for 6 s.

shide_strike.name: Shide Strike
shide_strike.description: Strike the creature you look at for 6 holy damage, doubled against undead, and apply soulburn for 4 s.

shimenawa_circle.name: Shimenawa Circle
shimenawa_circle.description: A 6-block ring soulburns enemies 4 s with Slowness I and gives allies Speed I for 6 s.

shiro_fracture.name: Shiro Fracture
shiro_fracture.description: Strike the looked-at target, freezing it 3 s and shattering 4 armour for 8 s.

shock_purse.name: Shock Purse
shock_purse.description: Throw a coin pouch that stuns enemies within 3 blocks of impact for 2 s.

sleight_palm.name: Sleight Palm
sleight_palm.description: Strike the creature you look at and steal one of its active potion effects.

slick_floor.name: Slick Floor
slick_floor.description: Coat the ground within 4 blocks in ice and gain Speed II for 5 s while enemies slip.

snowblind_shot.name: Snowblind Shot
snowblind_shot.description: Throw a packed snowball that blinds the target 3 s and applies Slowness II 5 s.

snowshoe_bound.name: Snowshoe Bound
snowshoe_bound.description: Leap 8 blocks forward and gain Speed II for 10 s while on snow or ice.

soulflame_rift.name: Soulflame Rift
soulflame_rift.description: Open a 4-block rift for 5 s that pulls enemies toward its centre and applies soulburn.

spearfishers_focus.name: Spearfisher's Focus
spearfishers_focus.description: For 10 s hits on wet or swimming targets deal +50% damage and pull them 2 blocks closer.

stags_crown.name: Stag's Crown
stags_crown.description: For 12 s your melee hits knock enemies back 3 blocks and grant you Speed I for 3 s.

static_kata.name: Static Kata
static_kata.description: For 10 seconds, every fifth unarmed hit stuns the target for 2 seconds.

storm_jerky.name: Storm Jerky
storm_jerky.description: Conjure jerky; eating grants Speed II and Jump Boost II for 30 s.

stormsurge_leap.name: Stormsurge Leap
stormsurge_leap.description: Leap 10 blocks forward; on landing, lightning strikes enemies within 3 blocks.

sun_salutation.name: Sun Salutation
sun_salutation.description: Create a 4-block area for 6 seconds giving allies Fire Resistance and Strength I and igniting enemies.

sunrise_quiver.name: Sunrise Quiver
sunrise_quiver.description: Your next 3 arrows within 10 s make targets glow and deal +4 holy damage to undead.

taiga_bulwark.name: Taiga Bulwark
taiga_bulwark.description: Raise a 5-wide wall of packed snow and spruce leaves in front of you for 10 s.

thunder_halo.name: Thunder Halo
thunder_halo.description: A 5-block thunder ring stuns enemies 2 s and heals allies 4 HP.

thunderseed.name: Thunderseed
thunderseed.description: Throw a seed that sprouts and calls lightning on impact after 2 s, granting nearby allies Regeneration I.

tithe_strike.name: Tithe Strike
tithe_strike.description: For 8 s, each hit heals you 1 HP and has a 20% chance to drop a gold nugget.

tolling_bell.name: Tolling Bell
tolling_bell.description: A ghost-bell ring hits enemies within 6 blocks with Glowing and Slowness II for 5 s.

undertow_frost.name: Undertow Frost
undertow_frost.description: Pull all enemies within 6 blocks toward you and freeze them for 3 s.

usury_pact.name: Usury Pact
usury_pact.description: For 10 s, each kill drops an extra emerald and refunds 20% of your mana.

vine_lash.name: Vine Lash
vine_lash.description: Lash the creature you look at up to 8 blocks away, pulling it to you and applying Poison I.

void_burrow.name: Void Burrow
void_burrow.description: Build a 3x3 obsidian shelter around you that vanishes after 8 s.

walk_the_plank.name: Walk the Plank
walk_the_plank.description: Shove the creature you look at 6 blocks away and soak it: Slowness II and Wet for 6 s.

wandering_storm.name: Wandering Storm
wandering_storm.description: For 15 s, while sprinting, enemies within 3 blocks are zapped every second.

wheel_of_agni.name: Wheel of Agni
wheel_of_agni.description: Spin-kick a 4-block ring, knocking creatures back and setting them on fire for 4 seconds.

winter_pact.name: Winter Pact
winter_pact.description: Sacrifice 4 HP to gain Absorption II and make your hits freeze targets 2 s for 10 s.

winterberry_bunch.name: Winterberry Bunch
winterberry_bunch.description: Conjure winterberries; eating grants Regeneration II 8 s and immunity to freezing for 60 s.

withering_spores.name: Withering Spores
withering_spores.description: Throw a spore pod that creates a 4-block cloud for 5 s, applying wither I and poison I.

yurei_breath.name: Yurei Breath
yurei_breath.description: Exhale a 5-block cone of ghostly cold that soulburns 3 s and applies Slowness II 4 s.

zazen_aim.name: Zazen Aim
zazen_aim.description: For 10 seconds, while standing still, your arrows deal 50% more damage and home in on targets.
